Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class ConsumableEffectComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.player.ConsumableEffectComponent
public class ConsumableEffectComponent extends Component
Owns consumable use: validates, removes exactly one item, applies its effect, then emits itemUsed. Input requests use through tryUse or useConsumable; itemUsed is a success notification only.
